name: nnyj-tweaks
description: QoL bundle: timed policy override toggles, locked-group editor placement, locked empty group close, line highlights, each feature toggleable

commands.title: Line Highlight: Toggle on Selected Lines

nnyjTweaks.policyToggle.enabled.description: Status bar toggle for temporary policy ask-group overrides.

nnyjTweaks.openLeft.enabled.description: Swap auto-split file groups to the left of locked webview groups.

nnyjTweaks.closeEmpty.enabled.description: Close a locked editor group once its last tab closes.

nnyjTweaks.lineHighlight.color.description: Highlight background color, hex with alpha.

nnyjTweaks.policyToggle.policyPath.description: Path to policy.json, source of ask group names.

nnyjTweaks.policyToggle.overridesPath.description: Path to the overrides file read by the policy guards.

nnyjTweaks.policyToggle.durations.description: Durations offered in the picker. Suffix m, h, or d.
